name: vbor
signature: int vbor(const int *a, const int *aa, const int *b, const int *c, const int *d, const int *e, int *x, int n, int ld)

contract.execution: One execution of the original repetition-loop body, including local setup. Retain the explicitly reviewed post-loop computation.

scalar_output.source_computation: temp = 0.; for (int i = 0; i < LEN; i++){ temp += x[i]; }

contract.aliasing: Distinct array arguments must have non-overlapping storage, matching the original globals. No restrict qualifier is added.
contract.arithmetic: Every evaluated signed arithmetic expression must be representable as int. Signed overflow is not defined as wraparound.
contract.memory: All array arguments are valid initialized buffers, also when n=0. No alignment beyond int alignment is required.
contract.notes: One valid aa row of n columns. Retain all original staged products and the post-loop sum; every product and checksum prefix must fit int.

row_stride.padding: Columns [n, ld) of each row are preserved.
row_stride.allocation: The mathematical ld*sizeof(int) must fit in SIZE_MAX and in the supplied allocation.

contract.extent_adaptation: Supply one valid row of n columns; do not reproduce cross-row aa[0][i] accesses when original LEN exceeds LEN2.

adaptations: remove harness and execute one computational repetition
single-row LEN-column matrix with explicit ld; no out-of-row reads
expose postlude's scalar observation as the return value
retain reviewed post-loop summation; replace global temp by a returned local checksum

experiment_caveats.aggregate_policy: report separately; do not silently pool with ordinary integer kernels

testing.description: Logical input values in [-2,2], including uniform +/-2 trials. Each x has magnitude <=737280; at the tester's n<=128, every checksum prefix has magnitude <=94371840. Padding is not clamped.
